task: Determine whether user U-4471 can use the bulk export feature, and either run the export or tell them what to do next.

steps.text: Bulk export is a Pro-tier feature. I need to check U-4471's current plan before deciding.

No pending upgrade found. Since the user is on Free tier, I'll let them know bulk export requires upgrading to Pro.
You're currently on the Free tier, which doesn't include bulk export. Please upgrade to Pro to unlock this feature.
